title: LG watch not working with xdrip since wear OS update
symptom: The latest Wear OS update has broken the X Drip watch face. On the watch, the xdrip readings often lag, show missed readings when in fact the reading is not missed and at times the watch face appears disconnected from app.
fix: The issue was resolved by performing the following steps: 1) Factory reset the LG Sport watch. 2) Update the watch to the current Wear OS release (Oct 2018). 3) Install the latest xdrip+ nightly (Oct 15th 2018) on the Pixel 2 XL. 4) Install the xdrip+ watch face on the LG Sport watch (google play.. apps on my phone). 5) Watch face works without issues.
evidence_quote: I have resolved this issue by performing the following steps: 1) Factory reset the LG Sport watch. 2) Update the watch to the current Wear OS release( Oct 2018 ). 3) Install the latest xdrip+ nightly ( Oct 15th 2018) on my Pixel 2 XL. 4) Install the xdrip+ watch face on the my LG sport watch ( google play.. apps on my phone ) 5) Watch face works without issues.
